agent_explanation: Between step 6 and 7 the two circles collide at high relative speed (~48 m/s). Correct elastic/inelastic collision should conserve momentum and not increase total energy beyond ~10% +5J. Instead momentum in x jumps from ~-48 Kg·m/s to ~-787 Kg·m/s and total energy jumps from ~1790 J to ~23888 J. Body 0 (16.9 kg, initially near rest) is accelerated to ~51 m/s while body 1 (1 kg) retains ~45 m/s, implying the impulse is applied with wrong effective mass / sign or repeatedly within the 24 substeps of step 7, injecting energy instead of redistributing it. Lowering impact speed removes the anomaly.
